description: This file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Plain, which provides methods for decorating and formatting debug output, particularly in different modes such as CLI, plain, and whitespace. It includes properties for ANSI color effects, symbols for various environments, and methods for decorating variable data and trace information.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Plain
classes.description: A class providing static methods for displaying decorated debug output across different modes (CLI, plain, whitespace). It manages color effects, symbols, and formatting of variable data and stack traces.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Recursively formats a kintVariableData object based on the specified level, producing decorated output with headers, extended values, and nested structures.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Formats a backtrace array into a decorated string, including function calls, file info, arguments, and objects involved in each step.

methods.name: _colorize
methods.description: Applies color or style formatting to text based on the current mode and the given type, supporting CLI, plain, and whitespace modes.

methods.name: _char
methods.description: Returns repeated characters or symbols based on environment mode, translating special characters into appropriate environment-specific symbols.

methods.name: _title
methods.description: Creates a decorated header title box with borders, formatted for the current mode.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Returns opening tags or formatting for the decorated output, depending on mode.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Returns closing tags or formatting, optionally including a 'called from' line, depending on mode.

methods.name: _drawHeader
methods.description: Constructs a header string for a variable including access, name, operator, type, size, and value, all decorated accordingly.

methods.name: _buildCalleeString
methods.description: Builds a string representing the callee's file and line, formatted as a URL or plain text based on mode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes color support based on environment and returns style tags for plain mode.
